EOI - Malawi - Consultancy to Conduct Capacity Building and Learning Visits for Actors in Digital Financial Services and Competition and Fair Trading Commission (CFTC) - DFIC
18-Aug-2026
The main objective of the consultancy is to build technical capacity of actors in digital financial services and consumer protection so as to enable them identify, address, and manage risks in the evolving digital finance and consumer protection landscape. Specifically, the CB and learning visits will enhance understanding of products, services and innovations, policies and strategies, regulation and compliance with DFS and consumer protection standards, as well as provide peer learning exposure for both digital finance and consumer protection actors for institutional sustainability.
